rows.grounds: compound locative indicating a different day
first-person promise to give the offering later

items.question: What promise and departure are required after accepting the offering on another day?
premises: The speaker promises to give the offering on another day.
After acceptance, departure to one's own house is prescribed.
items.inference: Accepting the offering entails a promise to give it on another day followed by returning home.
uncertainties: The specific object of dāsyāmi is implied from the preceding context (the offering).
items.plain_english: I shall also give it on another day; having accepted it, one should go to one's own house.
